title: Event Sourcing Pattern
description: Learn the event sourcing pattern and how it enables powerful audit trails and state reconstruction.

data.text: Event sourcing stores the complete history of state changes as a sequence of events. Instead of storing the current state, you store all events that led to the current state. Netflix, Uber, and financial systems use event sourcing for audit trails and state reconstruction.

In event sourcing, every state change is captured as an immutable event. The current state is derived by replaying events from the beginning. This provides a complete audit trail and enables time travel—you can reconstruct the state at any point in time.

data.title: Key Components
items: Event stream: Immutable log of all events for an entity
Event store: Persistent storage for events (Kafka, Event Store DB)
Projection: Materialized view built by replaying events
Snapshot: Periodic checkpoint to speed up state reconstruction

data.title: Event Store DB
data.text: Event Store DB is a database designed specifically for event sourcing. It supports optimistic concurrency, idempotent writes, and subscriptions to event streams.

data.title: Example: Bank Account with Event Sourcing
data.code: A bank account is reconstructed by replaying deposit and withdrawal events.

items.question: When should I use event sourcing?
items.answer: Use event sourcing when you need audit trails, time travel, or complex state reconstruction. It is overkill for simple CRUD applications.

items.question: What about event schema changes?
items.answer: Use upcasters to transform old events to new schemas when replaying. Keep events immutable; never modify or delete them.

items.question: How do I query events efficiently?
items.answer: Build projections (materialized views) optimized for your queries. Do not query the event stream directly for complex queries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Event sourcing stores state changes as immutable events
Current state is derived by replaying events
Provides complete audit trail and time travel
data.takeaway: Event sourcing is powerful for domains requiring auditability and complex state management.
